title: Sydney Water Customer Contract 2024-2028
regulator: Independent Pricing and Regulatory Tribunal (IPART) NSW, via the Sydney Water Operating Licence
source_version: Customer Contract 2024-2028, as at 1 July 2024 (Schedule B of the Operating Licence 2024-2028)
licence: Copyright the publisher. Paraphrased only; consult the source.
verification_notes: Checked on 2026-10-27 against the primary text (Customer Contract 2024-2028, as at 1 July 2024 (Schedule B of the Operating Licence 2024-2028)). Who is bound: NSW, Sydney Water Corporation only. Between Sydney Water and property-owner customers (cl 2.1(1) 'valid, legally binding and enforceable'; cl 2.2). Under Operating Licence cl 21(1), Sydney Water must also apply cl 6, 7.5 and 13 to consumers such as tenants as if they were parties. The contract states the Sydney Water Act 1994 (NSW) requires it (cl 2.1(2)). Clause text is paraphrased from the source. Not verified: The PDF is from Sydney Water's own site. IPART's December 2023 page has only the draft. I did not check whether Sydney Water has varied the contract under s 59 since 1 July 2024. I did not read the Sydney Water Act 1994 (NSW) itself, so the section that requires the contract is not given. The Payment Assistance Policy and Overdue Payments Policy referred to in cl 7.1(5) were not read. Other NSW water utilities (Hunter Water, WaterNSW, local councils) were not covered.. A compliance SME must confirm before reliance.
summary: Sydney Water Customer Contract 2024-2028. Bound: NSW, Sydney Water Corporation only. Between Sydney Water and property-owner customers (cl 2.1(1) 'valid, legally binding and enforceable'; cl 2.2). Under Operating Licence cl 21(1), Sydney Water must also apply cl 6, 7.5 and 13 to consumers such as tenants as if they were parties. The contract states the Sydney Water Act 1994 (NSW) requires it (cl 2.1(2)).

clauses.heading: Account queries and billing disputes
clauses.text: If an amount Sydney Water says a customer owes is in unresolved dispute, Sydney Water will not seek the disputed amount until the dispute is resolved.
clauses.notes: Provision read: cl 5.11(2). Agent demands payment of a disputed amount or threatens collection while the dispute is open.

clauses.heading: Payment difficulties and assistance options
clauses.text: A customer experiencing payment difficulty has the right to be treated sensitively, to have the difficulty dealt with fairly and reasonably, to seek a short payment deferral, and to be referred to financial counselling, among other options.
clauses.notes: Provision read: cl 6.1(2). Agent dismisses payment difficulty, refuses deferral or a payment arrangement (residential), or omits financial counselling and concession options.

clauses.heading: Payment arrangement protections
clauses.text: While a customer honours a payment arrangement, Sydney Water will waive interest and late payment fees on the overdue balance for the period and will not take legal action, or restrict or disconnect supply, to enforce the debt.
clauses.notes: Provision read: cl 6.1(4). Agent tells a customer honouring an arrangement that restriction, legal action, interest or late fees may still apply.

clauses.heading: Limitations on restriction or disconnection
clauses.text: Sydney Water will not restrict or disconnect supply where it has been told the customer needs drinking water for a life support machine or other special needs, or while a related complaint is being considered by Sydney Water, EWON or a court, among other limits.
clauses.notes: Provision read: cl 7.5(e)-(f). Agent threatens restriction of a life support household or of a customer with a live complaint at Sydney Water or EWON.

clauses.heading: Complaints review and external dispute resolution
clauses.text: A customer still dissatisfied after Sydney Water's internal complaint and review process may take the dispute to the Energy and Water Ombudsman NSW (EWON), whose services are free.
clauses.notes: Provision read: cl 13.2(2)(g), 13.4(1),(3). Agent fails to log a complaint, refuses manager review, or does not mention EWON (free) to an unsatisfied customer.
